name: Search
description: The search form in a site's navigation: a text field with an icon button, White on a Blue navbar, turning Rain on hover and focus, and the button that shows it on small screens. It's built like an input group, but its look is its own: a 2px border, a divider between field and button, and an icon-only button.
sources: Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: .az-search, made stable by az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2277
Arizona Bootstrap's latest 5.x release: below 992px, .az-search is 35px tall with 4px corners (set with the fullscreen navbar's styles)

root.description: The search form: a field and an icon button inside one border, on a Blue navbar.

padding.x.$description: Space to the left and right of the search form.

padding.y.$description: Space above and below the search form.

height.$description: Height of a text field with an attached button below the lg breakpoint (992px).
Height of a text field with an attached button from the lg breakpoint (992px) up.

divider.description: The line between the field and the button.

transition.duration.$description: How long the divider's color takes to change when the field gains or loses focus. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the divider's color change. Not yet reviewed by design. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

button.description: The submit button, an icon only.

padding.$description: Space around the attached button's icon.

size.$description: The attached button's icon width and height.

toggle.description: The button that shows the search form on small screens.
